**Root cause, measured in-process against the live ledger** (OpenCode DB, 21.7 GB, 656,459 route_attempt rows): `buildQuotaAnalytics` ran seven route_attempt aggregate scans per build; only the two burn scans were cached (120 s). The other five — last-hour burn, credential coverage, hourly-7d, day-of-week over the *entire* table (no WHERE clause), daily-21d — ran on **every** request: ~5.4 s of scans per warm build, ~10 s cold, all synchronous on Bun's single event loop, so concurrent loads queued behind each other (hence /quota at 9.4 s/18.8 s in my pre-fix probes and the knock-on stalls on / and /today). /api/quota.json was always 0.04 s — it never builds analytics.
